arguments.command:
python3 -c "
feb_1938 = 528
jan_1939 = 693

# Absolute percent difference: |v1 - v2| / ((v1 + v2) / 2) * 100
abs_diff = abs(feb_1938 - jan_1939)
avg = (feb_1938 + jan_1939) / 2

print(f'January 1939 expenditures: ${jan_1939} million')
print(f'Absolute difference: {abs_diff} million')
print(f'Average: {avg}')
print(f'Absolute percent difference: {percent_diff}%')
print(f'Rounded to nearest tenth: {round(percent_diff, 1)}%')
"
